ex.en: He got a master's degree in law.
ex.zh: 他拿到了法學碩士學位。

ex.en: She has a degree in computer science.
ex.zh: 她擁有資訊工程學位。

ex.en: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
ex.zh: 90 度的角叫做直角。

ex.en: Today, the temperature rose as high as 30 degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 今天氣溫高達攝氏 30 度。

ex.en: To what degree are you interested in baseball?
ex.zh: 你對棒球有多大的興趣？

ex.en: To what degree can we trust him?
ex.zh: 我們可以相信他到什麼程度？

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
ex.zh: 全新設計的操作介面，讓你在不同裝置上都能玩得更順暢。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置被牢牢固定在天花板上。

ex.en: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
ex.zh: 把他的名字從應徵者名單上刪掉。

ex.en: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
ex.zh: 真希望我知道怎麼刪除臉書帳號。

ex.en: Delete Tom's name from the list.
ex.zh: 從名單上刪掉湯姆的名字。

ex.en: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.
ex.zh: 大部分開發者都討厭除錯；寫出 bug 比修 bug 有趣多了。

ex.en: It took me two hours to debug the program.
ex.zh: 我花了兩個小時幫這個程式除錯。

ex.en: Our country designed the first electronic computer in 1941.
ex.zh: 我們國家在 1941 年設計出第一台電子計算機。

ex.en: My friend is designing a user interface for the new operating system.
ex.zh: 我朋友正在為新的作業系統設計使用者介面。

ex.en: These dresses were designed by the same designer.
ex.zh: 這幾件衣服是同一位設計師設計的。

ex.en: Tom's designs didn't impress me much.
ex.zh: 湯姆的設計沒給我留下什麼印象。

ex.en: He studies French and web design.
ex.zh: 他在學法文和網頁設計。

ex.en: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
ex.zh: 棕櫚油生產是印尼森林砍伐的主要原因。

ex.en: Deforestation destroys the homes of many animals.
ex.zh: 森林砍伐摧毀了許多動物的棲地。

ex.en: How often do you have to see the dentist?
ex.zh: 你多久要看一次牙醫？

ex.en: If your tooth hurts, you should see a dentist.
ex.zh: 如果牙齒痛，就應該去看牙醫。

ex.en: I wish to become a dentist in the future.
ex.zh: 我希望將來能當牙醫。

ex.en: What time does the train for New York depart?
ex.zh: 往紐約的火車幾點出發？

ex.en: The plane I'm taking departs at six o'clock.
ex.zh: 我搭的飛機六點起飛。

ex.en: His train is departing from platform 10.
ex.zh: 他的火車從十號月台發車。

depart.zh: depart from：背離、違反（慣例、計畫）

ex.en: We won't depart from the original plan.
ex.zh: 我們不會偏離原本的計畫。

ex.en: The new design departs from the company's traditional style.
ex.zh: 新的設計跳脫了公司的傳統風格。

ex.en: This new project in Java doesn't concern me at all, because I'm a PHP developer.
ex.zh: 這個新的 Java 專案跟我無關，因為我是 PHP 開發人員。

ex.en: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.
ex.zh: 大部分開發人員都討厭除錯，製造 bug 比修 bug 好玩多了。

ex.en: We are hiring two web developers.
ex.zh: 我們正在招募兩位網頁開發人員。

ex.en: The developer plans to build 200 new homes here.
ex.zh: 建商計畫在這裡蓋兩百戶新房子。

ex.en: The land was sold to a property developer.
ex.zh: 這塊地賣給了一家房地產開發商。

ex.en: The USS Monitor was designated the first National Marine Sanctuary on January 30, 1975.
ex.zh: 莫尼特號於 1975 年 1 月 30 日被指定為美國第一個國家海洋保護區。

ex.en: This area is designated for smokers only.
ex.zh: 這個區域是指定吸菸區。

ex.en: She was designated as the team leader.
ex.zh: 她被指派為團隊負責人。

ex.en: I have a dental appointment at three.
ex.zh: 我三點約了看牙醫。

ex.en: Does the insurance cover dental care?
ex.zh: 這份保險有給付牙科治療嗎？

ex.en: She decorated her room with roses.
ex.zh: 她用玫瑰花裝飾了她的房間。

ex.en: Tom helped Mary decorate her Christmas tree.
ex.zh: 湯姆幫瑪莉裝飾聖誕樹。

ex.en: You can decorate the cocktail with a cherry or a pineapple.
ex.zh: 你可以用一顆櫻桃或一片鳳梨來裝飾這杯調酒。

ex.en: The decorating isn't bad.
ex.zh: 裝潢得還不錯。

ex.en: We're decorating the bedroom this weekend.
ex.zh: 這週末我們要重新粉刷臥室。

ex.en: Tax deductions are taken from your salary.
ex.zh: 稅款會從你的薪水中扣除。

ex.en: You can claim a deduction for medical expenses.
ex.zh: 醫療費用可以申報扣除額。

ex.en: His deduction turned out to be correct.
ex.zh: 他的推論結果是正確的。

ex.en: She solved the case by logical deduction.
ex.zh: 她靠邏輯推理破了案。

ex.en: I cannot give you a definite answer today.
ex.zh: 我今天無法給您明確的答覆。

ex.en: It is definite that he will go to America.
ex.zh: 他確定要去美國了。

ex.en: We need a definite date for the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個確定的開會日期。

ex.en: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
ex.zh: 我在桌面上建立了一個捷徑。

ex.en: Save the file to your desktop.
ex.zh: 把檔案存到桌面。

ex.en: A laptop is better than a desktop.
ex.zh: 筆電比桌上型電腦好。

ex.en: Our office replaced the old desktops with laptops.
ex.zh: 我們辦公室把舊的桌上型電腦換成了筆電。

ex.en: Taxes are deducted from your salary every month.
ex.zh: 稅金每個月會從你的薪水扣除。

ex.en: The hotel deducted the damage from our deposit.
ex.zh: 飯店從我們的押金裡扣了損壞的費用。

ex.en: Points will be deducted for late submissions.
ex.zh: 遲交會被扣分。

ex.en: She stood on the deck with her long hair waving in the wind.
ex.zh: 她站在甲板上，長髮隨風飄揚。

ex.en: Let's go up to the top deck to enjoy the view.
ex.zh: 我們上頂層欣賞風景吧。

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把那副撲克牌放到橡木桌上。

ex.en: The deck was poorly shuffled.
ex.zh: 這副牌沒洗勻。

ex.en: Can you send me the slide deck before the meeting?
ex.zh: 會議前可以把簡報檔寄給我嗎？

ex.en: I'm still working on the pitch deck.
ex.zh: 我還在做提案簡報。

ex.en: Please write a more descriptive title for your report.
ex.zh: 請幫你的報告下一個更具體的標題。

ex.en: The product page needs more descriptive text.
ex.zh: 產品頁面需要更多描述性的文字。

ex.en: Detach the bottom part of the form and return it.
ex.zh: 把表格下半部撕下來交回。

ex.en: You can detach the keyboard from the tablet.
ex.zh: 這個鍵盤可以從平板上拆下來。

ex.en: Hard work and dedication will bring you success.
ex.zh: 努力和投入會讓你成功。

ex.en: Thank you for your dedication to the team.
ex.zh: 謝謝你為團隊的付出。

dealership.zh: 經銷商（尤指汽車）；經銷權

ex.en: He works at a car dealership.
ex.zh: 他在一家汽車經銷商上班。

ex.en: We bought our new car from a local dealership.
ex.zh: 我們在當地的經銷商買了新車。

ex.en: I wonder if Tom and Mary are dependable.
ex.zh: 不知道湯姆和瑪麗可不可靠。

ex.en: She is a dependable employee.
ex.zh: 她是很可靠的員工。

ex.en: We need a dependable supplier.
ex.zh: 我們需要一家可靠的供應商。

debit.zh: 借記、扣款（debit card：簽帳金融卡）

ex.en: Can I pay by debit card?
ex.zh: 我可以用簽帳金融卡付款嗎？

ex.en: The debit will appear on your next statement.
ex.zh: 這筆扣款會出現在你下一期的對帳單上。

ex.en: The amount will be debited from your account.
ex.zh: 這筆金額會從你的帳戶扣款。

ex.en: The bank debited my account twice by mistake.
ex.zh: 銀行不小心從我的帳戶扣了兩次款。

ex.en: He was a weak and delicate child.
ex.zh: 他小時候是個體弱多病的孩子。

ex.en: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in delicate health.
ex.zh: 她確實年輕又漂亮，但身體很虛弱。

ex.en: Be careful, these glasses are very delicate.
ex.zh: 小心，這些玻璃杯很容易破。

delicate.zh: 微妙的、棘手的、需小心處理的

ex.en: It's a very delicate question.
ex.zh: 這是個非常敏感的問題。

ex.en: It's a delicate situation.
ex.zh: 那是個很微妙的情況。

ex.en: That's a delicate matter.
ex.zh: 那是一件很敏感的事。

ex.en: We need to reduce our dependence on oil.
ex.zh: 我們必須減少對石油的依賴。

ex.en: His dependence on coffee is getting worse.
ex.zh: 他越來越依賴咖啡了。

ex.en: We booked a deluxe room with an ocean view.
ex.zh: 我們訂了一間海景豪華客房。

ex.en: The deluxe version costs 20 dollars more.
ex.zh: 豪華版要多二十元。

desirable.zh: 令人嚮往的、理想的；（條件）最好具備的

ex.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
ex.zh: 我們沒有的東西，似乎總是最令人嚮往。

ex.en: Sales experience is desirable but not required.
ex.zh: 有業務經驗尤佳，但非必要。

ex.en: This is a very desirable neighborhood to live in.
ex.zh: 這是一個非常理想的居住地區。

ex.en: The old building will be demolished next month.
ex.zh: 這棟舊大樓下個月將被拆除。

ex.en: They demolished the factory to build apartments.
ex.zh: 他們拆掉工廠來蓋公寓。

ex.en: She demolished his argument in minutes.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘就駁倒了他的論點。

ex.en: The new evidence demolished their theory.
ex.zh: 新證據推翻了他們的理論。

ex.en: We have a departmental meeting every Monday.
ex.zh: 我們每週一有部門會議。

ex.en: Each manager must submit a departmental budget.
ex.zh: 每位經理都必須提交部門預算。

desperate.zh: 絕望的、危急的；孤注一擲的

ex.en: I'm in a desperate situation.
ex.zh: 我陷入了絕境。

ex.en: Desperate times call for desperate measures.
ex.zh: 非常時期需要非常手段。

desperate.zh: 極度渴望的（be desperate for / to）

ex.en: I'm desperate for a cup of coffee.
ex.zh: 我超想喝杯咖啡。

ex.en: The company is desperate to cut costs.
ex.zh: 公司急著要削減成本。

ex.en: The country had been devastated by long war.
ex.zh: 這個國家被長年戰爭摧毀了。

ex.en: The typhoon devastated the coastal towns.
ex.zh: 颱風重創了沿海城鎮。

devastate.zh: 使極度震驚、使悲痛（常用 be devastated）

ex.en: She was devastated by the news.
ex.zh: 這個消息讓她傷心欲絕。

ex.en: Losing the contract devastated the whole team.
ex.zh: 失去這份合約讓整個團隊大受打擊。

ex.en: We put up decorations for the office party.
ex.zh: 我們為公司派對布置了裝飾。

ex.en: The Christmas decorations look beautiful.
ex.zh: 聖誕裝飾看起來很漂亮。

ex.en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
ex.zh: 這幾年空氣品質變差了。

ex.en: Tom's health has been deteriorating for some time.
ex.zh: 湯姆的健康狀況已經惡化一段時間了。

ex.en: The situation is deteriorating.
ex.zh: 情況正在惡化。

ex.en: Depreciation is recorded as a business expense.
ex.zh: 折舊列為營業費用。

ex.en: Cars suffer rapid depreciation in the first year.
ex.zh: 汽車在第一年折舊得很快。

ex.en: The depreciation of the currency made imports more expensive.
ex.zh: 貨幣貶值讓進口商品變貴了。

ex.en: Exporters benefited from the yen's depreciation.
ex.zh: 出口商受惠於日圓貶值。

ex.en: Any deviation from the plan must be approved.
ex.zh: 任何偏離計畫的變更都必須經過核准。

ex.en: There was a small deviation in the test results.
ex.zh: 測試結果有些微偏差。

ex.en: Plastic is a derivative of oil.
ex.zh: 塑膠是石油的衍生產品。

ex.en: "Happiness" is a derivative of "happy."
ex.zh: happiness 是 happy 的衍生字。

ex.en: Banks trade derivatives to manage risk.
ex.zh: 銀行交易衍生性金融商品來管理風險。

ex.en: Derivatives can be very risky for small investors.
ex.zh: 衍生性商品對散戶來說風險可能很高。

ex.en: Critics said the movie was derivative and boring.
ex.zh: 評論家說這部電影了無新意又無聊。

ex.en: His designs are too derivative of other brands.
ex.zh: 他的設計太像其他品牌了。

ex.en: The bank sent a final notice to the debtor.
ex.zh: 銀行寄了最後通知給債務人。

ex.en: The debtor agreed to pay in monthly installments.
ex.zh: 債務人同意按月分期付款。

ex.en: We decided to defer the decision until next month.
ex.zh: 我們決定把決定延到下個月。

ex.en: You can defer payment for up to 90 days.
ex.zh: 你最多可以延後 90 天付款。

defer.zh: defer to：聽從、尊重（他人意見）

ex.en: I'll defer to your judgment on this matter.
ex.zh: 這件事我就聽從你的判斷。

ex.en: She usually defers to her manager on technical issues.
ex.zh: 在技術問題上她通常尊重主管的意見。

ex.en: The project was deemed a success.
ex.zh: 這個專案被認為是成功的。

ex.en: Do whatever you deem necessary.
ex.zh: 你認為有必要的事就去做吧。

ex.en: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
ex.zh: 被告將向上級法院上訴。

ex.en: The court declared the defendant innocent.
ex.zh: 法院宣判被告無罪。

ex.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
ex.zh: 我不在的時候，他會代理我的職務。

ex.en: I'm your deputy.
ex.zh: 我是你的副手。

ex.en: She was promoted to deputy director.
ex.zh: 她升任副主任。

ex.en: The company deployed more staff to handle complaints.
ex.zh: 公司調派更多人手處理客訴。

ex.en: Resources must be deployed efficiently.
ex.zh: 資源必須有效配置。

ex.en: We will deploy the new version tonight.
ex.zh: 我們今晚會部署新版本。

ex.en: The app was deployed to the cloud server.
ex.zh: 這個 App 已部署到雲端伺服器。

ex.en: An asterisk denotes a required field.
ex.zh: 星號代表必填欄位。

ex.en: In this chart, blue denotes sales in Asia.
ex.zh: 在這張圖表中，藍色代表亞洲的銷售額。

ex.en: We need to devise a new strategy.
ex.zh: 我們需要想出新策略。

ex.en: The team devised a way to cut costs.
ex.zh: 團隊想出了一個降低成本的方法。

ex.en: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.
ex.zh: 我不是詩人，寫不出一句話來描繪它的美。

ex.en: The painting depicts a busy market.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一個熱鬧的市場。

ex.en: Cars depreciate quickly.
ex.zh: 汽車折舊得很快。

ex.en: The yen depreciated against the dollar.
ex.zh: 日圓對美元貶值。

ex.en: We depreciate equipment over five years.
ex.zh: 我們把設備分五年折舊。

ex.en: High prices may deter customers from buying.
ex.zh: 高價可能會讓顧客卻步。

ex.en: The cameras are there to deter thieves.
ex.zh: 裝攝影機是為了嚇阻小偷。

ex.en: Bad weather did not deter us from going.
ex.zh: 惡劣的天氣沒有阻止我們出發。

ex.en: Japan suffered from deflation for many years.
ex.zh: 日本多年來深受通貨緊縮之苦。

ex.en: Deflation can hurt the economy because people delay spending.
ex.zh: 通貨緊縮會讓人延後消費，進而傷害經濟。

ex.en: He makes a decent salary.
ex.zh: 他的薪水還不錯。

ex.en: Is there a decent restaurant near here?
ex.zh: 這附近有像樣的餐廳嗎？

ex.en: Tom is a decent guy.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個好人。

ex.en: Tom is a decent sort of guy.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個正派的人。

ex.en: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.
ex.zh: 我爸媽在的時候，請你說話注意分寸。

ex.en: Price is a key determinant of consumer choice.
ex.zh: 價格是影響消費者選擇的關鍵因素。

ex.en: Education is a major determinant of income.
ex.zh: 教育程度是決定收入的主要因素。

ex.en: Business travel expenses are tax deductible.
ex.zh: 商務出差費用可以抵稅。

ex.en: Are these donations deductible?
ex.zh: 這些捐款可以扣抵嗎？

ex.en: My car insurance has a 500-dollar deductible.
ex.zh: 我的汽車保險有 500 美元的自付額。

ex.en: You must pay the deductible before the insurance covers the rest.
ex.zh: 你必須先付自付額，保險才會支付其餘費用。

ex.en: The company issued debentures to raise funds.
ex.zh: 公司發行公司債來籌措資金。

ex.en: Debenture holders are paid before shareholders.
ex.zh: 公司債持有人會比股東先獲得償付。

ex.en: Tom deliberately broke the window.
ex.zh: 湯姆故意打破了那扇窗戶。

ex.en: He deliberately exposed her to danger.
ex.zh: 他故意讓她陷入危險。

ex.en: He spoke slowly and deliberately.
ex.zh: 他說話緩慢而謹慎。

ex.en: She walked deliberately to the front of the room.
ex.zh: 她從容地走到房間前方。

ex.en: Are some of you from the US trade delegation?
ex.zh: 請問各位是美國貿易代表團的成員嗎？

ex.en: The delegations of both countries met in Geneva.
ex.zh: 兩國代表團在日內瓦會面。

ex.en: Good managers are skilled at delegation.
ex.zh: 好的主管很懂得分派工作。

ex.en: Delegation of tasks saves everyone time.
ex.zh: 適當分派任務能幫大家節省時間。

ex.en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.
ex.zh: 那位政治人物藉由揭發政府官員的貪腐來推動改革。

ex.en: Many groups denounced the decision as unfair.
ex.zh: 許多團體譴責這項決定不公平。

ex.en: Deregulation of the airline industry led to lower fares.
ex.zh: 航空業解除管制後，票價降低了。

ex.en: Some experts blame deregulation for the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 有些專家把金融危機歸咎於解除管制。

ex.en: The loan is denominated in US dollars.
ex.zh: 這筆貸款以美元計價。

ex.en: Most oil contracts are denominated in dollars.
ex.zh: 大多數石油合約都以美元計價。

ex.en: The city lies on a river delta.
ex.zh: 這座城市位於河流的三角洲上。

ex.en: Rice is grown in the Mekong Delta.
ex.zh: 湄公河三角洲種植稻米。

ex.en: What's the delta between the two estimates?
ex.zh: 這兩個估算之間差多少？

ex.en: The delta in price is only five dollars.
ex.zh: 價差只有五美元。

ex.en: The devaluation of the currency made imports more expensive.
ex.zh: 貨幣貶值讓進口商品變得更貴。

ex.en: Exporters benefited from the devaluation of the yen.
ex.zh: 出口商受惠於日圓貶值。

ex.en: Boy Scouts need to do one good deed every day.

ex.zh: 最近的調查顯示吸菸人數在減少。

ex.en: My income has decreased ten percent.
ex.zh: 我的收入減少了百分之十。

ex.en: Canada's crime rate is decreasing.
ex.zh: 加拿大的犯罪率下降了。

ex.en: We saw a sharp decrease in complaints this year.
ex.zh: 今年客訴明顯減少。

ex.en: The decrease in sales worried the manager.
ex.zh: 銷售量下滑讓經理很擔心。

ex.en: The main deliverable is a working prototype.
ex.zh: 主要的交付成果是一個可以運作的原型。

ex.en: Please list all deliverables and their due dates.
ex.zh: 請列出所有交付項目和截止日期。

ex.en: The postman delivers letters every morning.
ex.zh: 郵差每天早上送信。

ex.en: We can deliver within a week.
ex.zh: 我們一週內就能送貨。

ex.en: How soon can they be delivered?
ex.zh: 這些多快能送到？

ex.en: She delivered an excellent speech at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上發表了一場精彩的演說。

ex.en: The CEO will deliver the opening remarks.
ex.zh: 執行長將發表開幕致詞。

ex.en: The new manager delivered on all his promises.
ex.zh: 新經理實現了他所有的承諾。

ex.en: We need a team that can deliver results.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個能交出成果的團隊。

ex.en: Careful! Emotional dependency is not synonymous with love!
ex.zh: 小心！情感上的依賴不等於愛！

ex.en: Tom has a caffeine dependency, doesn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆對咖啡因有依賴，對吧？

ex.en: This task has a dependency on the design team.
ex.zh: 這項工作要等設計團隊完成才能進行。

ex.en: List all dependencies before you set the timeline.
ex.zh: 排定時程前，先列出所有相依的工作。

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: I have missed the delivery time, what should I do next?
ex.zh: 我已經錯過交貨時間了，接下來該怎麼辦？

ex.en: The pizza delivery guy hasn't come by yet.
ex.zh: 送披薩的人還沒來。

ex.en: I don't make deals with people like you.
ex.zh: 我不跟你這種人做交易。

ex.en: We finally closed the deal with the new client.
ex.zh: 我們終於和新客戶談成了這筆交易。

ex.en: Tom could've dealt with the problem in a better way.
ex.zh: 湯姆其實可以用更好的方式處理這個問題。

ex.en: How long have you been dealing with this trouble?
ex.zh: 這個問題困擾你多久了？

ex.en: This book deals with life in the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: 這本書講的是英國的生活。

ex.en: We will deal with this problem in Chapter Three.
ex.zh: 我們會在第三章討論這個問題。

ex.en: We have to do a great deal of reading.
ex.zh: 我們要讀很多書。

ex.en: She knows a great deal about wine.
ex.zh: 她對葡萄酒懂得很多。

ex.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
ex.zh: 書桌上有一把剪刀。

ex.en: Tom and Mary got up from their desks.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗從他們各自的書桌前站起身來。

ex.en: This desk cost me no less than 30000 yen.
ex.zh: 這張書桌花了我至少三萬日圓。

ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.
ex.zh: 你必須在期限前完成這項工作。

ex.en: Can they finish this before the deadline?
ex.zh: 他們能在期限前完成嗎？

ex.en: Wow, I can't believe they actually met the deadline for once.
ex.zh: 哇，真不敢相信他們這次居然趕上了截止日期。

ex.en: She has to make her own decisions.
ex.zh: 她要自己做決定。

ex.en: Why didn't you consult me before taking this decision?
ex.zh: 你做這個決定之前，為什麼不先問過我？

ex.en: We have some decisions to make.
ex.zh: 我們要做些決定。
